name: Nightlist
summary: Overnight lung cancer trial screening for a community clinic: the model compiles public trial eligibility text into checks, and Zetaris runs them over patient data the model never sees.

meterless.nightshift: primary AI provider; Compiler uses route meterless/deep, Checker uses meterless/fast; 2,896 requests in two live runs (docs/nightshift-run.md)

sponsor_technology.nvidia: NVIDIA Nemotron served every model request in the live runs: nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b (2,889) and nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b (7), logged per request in logs/ and docs/nightshift-run.md
sponsor_technology.cursor: not used; built with a different AI coding assistant, which the rules allow

data.patients: 240 synthetic patients, no real patient data
